chunks: From Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The believers are brothers from one father and mother; when one of them is struck, the others lose sleep.

key_terms.إِخْوَةٌ: Brothers (plural of brother, indicating close kinship)
key_terms.بِنْ أَبٍ وَأُمٍّ: From one father and mother (indicating shared origin and closeness)
key_terms.سَهَرَ: Lost sleep / stayed awake (indicating concern and vigilance)
key_terms.عَرَقٌ: Sweat (metaphor for effort, hardship, or exertion)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual relationship between believers according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Kitab al-Mumin*, Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) elevates the believer's bond to a spiritual kinship, where the distress of one is the wakeful concern of all, reflecting the concept of *ta'azur* (mutual support). This imagery underscores the communal responsibility in Shia ethics, where individual suffering is not isolated but shared by the entire body of believers, mirroring the Prophet's own care for his Ummah.
